messages:
Noah (AE): Quick heads-up 3 DeltaHealth procurement wants the full SIG v3 Q-by-Q + attachments for ENCR/KEY/ACCESS by COB Wed. They flagged customer-managed keys and tenant isolation as blockers for procurement approval.
Tara (Security): Copy. Do they want CAIQ crosswalk too or just SIG answers with linked artifacts?
Noah (AE): They asked for a CAIQ mapping if it's not too much work. Main ask: question-level evidence for encryption, access control, and multi-tenant isolation.
Samir (Solutions): I can assemble the mapping. ETA Tue 11am. Which artifacts are mandatory from Security?
Tara (Security): Must-haves: redacted SOC2 (PDF), KMS policy + an ops runbook excerpt showing rotation, encryption-at-rest config (DB + object store), sample SCIM SCIM provisioning manifest, tenant isolation architecture diagram, recent container image scan summary, and a pen-test remediation tracker excerpt.
Jules (Legal): Reminder: redact PII, tenant IDs, internal hostnames, and IPs. Use secure-share with one-time access or short TTL. If they need full SOC2 we require a signed DPA first.
evidence-bot: Uploaded: SOC2_redacted_Q2_2025.pdf, kms_ops_runbook_snip.txt, tenant_isolation_arch.png, image_scan_may2025.csv
Samir (Solutions): Draft answer for SIG 3.4.2 (key rotation ownership): "We support customer-managed keys via cloud KMS and HSM integrations. Rotation is documented and can be performed without expected service disruption when following our runbook; SRE coordinates onboarding." Good?
Tara (Security): Good, but replace "HSM integrations" with a specific note: "HSM-backed keys supported for Private/Dedicated deployments." Also attach a brief CLI snippet.
Samir (Solutions): Adding CLI. Using a GCP example to vary from usual AWS snippets:
```
# gcloud example: schedule rotation (illustrative)
gcloud kms keys versions create --key ring=ri-keys --location=europe-west1 --key=my-key
# update service to point to new key version
kubectl set env deployment/ri-backend REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=projects/project/locations/europe-west1/keyRings/ri-keys/cryptoKeys/my-key/cryptoKeyVersions/2
```
Noah (AE): DeltaHealth also pressed on tenant isolation proof: they want network-level and logical tenant separation details and confirmation we don't co-mingle customer data in the same DB shard.
Tara (Security): We should state our default: logical separation within the same cluster (row-level encryption + customer-id scoping) for Hosted, and full tenant isolation (separate VPCs/legal tenancy) for Dedicated/Private. I'll craft the wording and attach the diagram.
Jules (Legal): If we mention "no co-mingling" be careful. Use "no co-mingling of customer-identifiable data for Dedicated/Private; Hosted uses strict logical controls and encryption-in-depth." I'll prepare approved phrasing.
Samir (Solutions): Mapping doc created: delta_sig_map_v1.xlsx (question -> suggested answer -> artifact filename). Flagged 6 items for Legal review.
Noah (AE): Pricing/POC note from procurement: they want an option for an in-region POC on Dedicated hardware for 4 weeks. Any blockers?
Tara (Security): Security-wise it's fine but ops must schedule. Also note: Dedicated POC would require a temporary DPA/addendum and an onboarding checklist for customer-managed keys.
Jules (Legal): I'll prep DPA + short addendum for POC use and HSM custody options.
Samir (Solutions): I'll bundle answers + artifacts into delta_sig_bundle_v1.zip and mark redactions in a README. Will upload to secure-share once Legal approves.
Noah (AE): Timeline: Samir/Tara finalize artifacts and mapping by Tue 11am, Jules to provide DPA/addendum by Tue 4pm, I'll deliver to DeltaHealth procurement Wed AM. Thanks team. :pray:
Tara (Security): One more thing: for SIG Q 5.2.1 (vuln management) I'll attach our CVE triage policy excerpt and the last 30-day open findings list (redacted).
Noah (AE): Perfect. evidence-bot: please upload final bundle when ready.
evidence-bot: Uploaded: delta_sig_map_v1.xlsx, delta_sig_bundle_v1.zip (pending legal sign-off).
